notes.title: Announcement of Sanguo Warriors VR's continued operations
notes.content:
Announcement of Sanguo Warriors VR's continued operations

Thank you for your support. Recently we are all making new gameplay and will meet you soon.
Before the team thought that the game was unpopular, it decided to put a new adjusted new version of the game after the shelves.
Later, we carefully studied the relevant information about Steam, and we didn't want to take back the games that the players had already purchased. And in the message and letter, there are still many players who like this game.
We decided to keep this game first.

Thank you again for your support and love!

notes.title: Sanguo Warriors VR release announcement
notes.content:
Sanguo Warriors VR will be removed when the Sanguo Warriors VR2 goes live.
Please pay attention.
If you have any questions, please contact the official FB, Twitter.
Or email: ezni2005@gmail.com

notes.title: Find hidden levels and customs clearance game activities
notes.content:
The first three players who discovered the game's hidden levels can contact us and give gifts.
We contacted us through friends who had cleared the story and BOSS checkpoints. We did some simple interviews.

https://www.facebook.com/sanguowarriors/

https://twitter.com/SanguoWarriors

notes.title: "Sanguo Warriors VR" to update the language, operation, and battle.
notes.content: The latest version adds dual action mode (smooth movement and sprint), dual language (Chinese and English), optimized Oculus operation. Increased physics of monsters and enhanced BOSS combat performance.
